text: Gomɗii arii e yimɓe Makka ɓen, Nulaaɗo jeyaaɗo e maɓɓe, mo ɓe anndiri hoolaare e goongugol, on woni Muhammadu (yo o his), kono ɓe fenni mo e ko jippiniraa kon e makko immorde ka Joomi makko. Lepte Alla ɗen jipporii e maɓɓe heege e kulol, tawde ko ɓe tooñirɓe ko'e-maɓɓe yollagol e halkaare, tuma ɓe sirkannoo Alla, ɓe fenni Nulaaɗo Makko on.
